dedupe_keys.name: unitcommitment jl a julia jump optimization package for security constrained unit commitment

description: The UnitCommitment.jl authors at Argonne and partner universities publish a Julia/JuMP package for security-constrained unit commitment. Zenodo archives version 0.4.2 under CC BY 4.0 and links the public repository. Its README describes a JSON case format, mixed-integer formulations, swappable grid-component extensions, and benchmark cases from 14 to 13,659 buses. Users can run day-ahead dispatch simulations with thermal and profiled generation, storage, demand, transmission constraints and reserves. A browser interface is also documented, although local Julia is the archived deployment. No related catalogue record or first-review draft explicitly covers this platform. Its geography and time resolution depend on a supplied grid case. A limitation is that benchmark scale does not establish solver speed or feasibility on a particular machine; the deposited release and live repository may differ. The archive was not downloaded, and no market-clearing or contingency result was reproduced.
